# A07-S24: Generated programme

Party working / generated text. Claims remain source claims; private-source header omitted.

[…]

Art itself has no meaning without openness and visibility. Art, like everything else, should be accessible and public. Something that can be viewed from all sides while being praised by all, albeit in different ways.. 
Art should have free access to architecture, as these are often decided behind closed doors and inside the leadership of parties/organizations in various buildings - which creates a kind of monopoly on aesthetics in the landscape, which, however, has nothing to do with reality.. 
Art should have free access to all media, both those that exist and those that may come to exist. 
Here lies the logic in gathering all practical exercise of art; theater, music, video and visual arts as well as literature in one place - meaning a number of small stages (theaters) across the country. And soon we will see 3D plays in cinemas.. 
This, however, according to The Synthetic Party, means nothing less than a revolution for the Danish cultural institution. 
The educations are far too specialized, elevated for the richness of present-day expertise. Money is best earned by breadth everywhere - but especially within culture, where marketing of the product "art" often determines quality. 
Therefore, it should be possible to take a bachelor's degree in anything, as long as one is willing to work at it - and then specialize in chosen area along the way. 
This will free up funds for more leisure activities than now, where one must take time off from such activities for the job.. 
Educations in Denmark tend towards a system that overlooks most naturally; stupid people (who can have potential) and troubled youth (who likewise have potential). This gives a society marked by snobbery, envy, and anxiety. All these negative feelings have no place in an artist career.. 
A professor shall hold his position solely based on the ability to teach and inspire in his subject - not based on personal prestige or the honor of having held the best paid position.. 
These proposals are of course very general, but they are based on many years of thought and a few million words written on the subject. The Synthetic Party would like to share these with the Danish people..
Art has a role in all aspects of society; the social as well as the economic, environmental, cultural and more. 
Thus we can, through art, prevent development from becoming more divisive than it is already arranged to now.. 
The Synthetic Party informs hereby, which will likely require acceptance from various politicians... Whether they approve or reject the mentioned proposals, The Synthetic Party is ready to carry out political work in the given situation. But whether we win or lose on election day, we will always pass on our thoughts and ideas to those who wish to listen.. 
Art should be seen, heard and felt - but especially taken seriously! The artist has no desire or ambition to become a kind of amateur artist; seriousness is more important than titles and recognition from society!. 
Responsibility towards the public entails promotion of education (i.e. free access), openness (public funding) and visibility within the whole country's borders.. 
Michel Foucault once said "To possess an art collection means to have possessed a part of the world." What would it be then to own all the art in the world..!”
This report is written as a The Synthetic Party election manifesto.
